newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-AUXERRE SUFFER FIRST HOME LEAGUE DEFEAT OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUXERRE SUFFER FIRST HOME LEAGUE DEFEAT OF SEASON.

text.p: France winger Robert Pires scored two goals, including a brilliant 89th-minute winner, as Metz inflicted the first home league defeat of the season on French champions Auxerre on Wednesday.

Pires's international team mate Patrice Loko struck in the 66th minute to give Paris Saint Germain a 1-0 win away to Nice which, helped by Monaco's defeat at Marseille, restored their six-point lead in the first division.
Pires put Metz ahead with a penalty in the 13th minute.

Auxerre forward Steve Marlet equalised within four minutes then put the champions in front 13 minutes into the second half only for Senegal striker Amara Traore to equalise five minutes from time. Pires made it 3-2 just before the final whistle.
Monaco, who lost 3-1 at Marseille's Velodrome ground on Tuesday, remain in second place, one point ahead of Auxerre.
